title: Shared mix report terms
description: What a mix report's words mean wherever one is shown: the website's mix report, locallibrary's HTML report, its terminal player and the sets it publishes.

blendSecs.description: How long two tracks must be heard together, in seconds, to call the transition a blend (a published set's `technique`). Fingerprints don't hear fades, so a shorter overlap may be a quick mix as well as a cut.
